name: Leomund's Secret Chest

components.m: a chest 3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet made of rare materials worth 5,000+ GP, and a Tiny replica of it made of the same materials worth 50+ GP

summary: Hide a chest (up to 12 cubic feet of contents) on the Ethereal Plane and call it back with a Magic action.
text: You hide a chest and everything in it on the Ethereal Plane, touching both the chest and the miniature replica that serve as the material component. The chest can hold up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet). While the chest is on the Ethereal Plane, you can take a Magic action to touch the replica and bring the chest back to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, and another Magic action sends it back. After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance each day that the spell ends. The spell also ends if you cast it again or if the replica is destroyed. If it ends while the chest is on the Ethereal Plane, the chest stays there and can still be found. Lasts until dispelled.
